goal: Reproduce the stock TRM Sudoku-Extreme baseline (as-is) to anchor Phase B.

reference.paper: arXiv:2510.04871 (Jolicoeur-Martineau, Less is More: Recursive Reasoning with Tiny Networks)

variant: TRM-MLP (attention-free MLP-Mixer; best on Sudoku; no flash-attn required)

arch.recursion_note: H_cycles=T=3, L_cycles=n=6; deep supervision N_sup<=16; single shared 2-layer net; full backprop through the last recursion pass

train.global_batch_size: repo default (to be recorded from the run; may be tuned for 32GB)

hardware.flash_attn: not installed (unnecessary for the MLP/Sudoku path)

status: SETUP COMMITTED; execution pending network approvals (clone, deps, dataset)
